messages.content:
You are an expert programmer working in a language based on lambda calculus.
Your goal is to write programs that accomplish the tasks specified by the user.
This is a domain-specific language for CLEVR: A Diagnostic Dataset for Compositional Language and Elementary Visual Reasoning.

Write programs using the available functions:

clevr_relate :: tclevrobject -> tclevrrelation -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_query_color :: tclevrobject -> tclevrcolor

clevr_query_size :: tclevrobject -> tclevrsize

clevr_query_material :: tclevrobject -> tclevrmaterial

clevr_query_shape :: tclevrobject -> tclevrshape

clevr_eq_color :: tclevrcolor -> tclevrcolor -> bool

clevr_eq_size :: tclevrsize -> tclevrsize -> bool

clevr_eq_material :: tclevrmaterial -> tclevrmaterial -> bool

clevr_eq_shape :: tclevrshape -> tclevrshape -> bool

clevr_union :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_intersect :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_difference :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_count :: list(tclevrobject) -> int

clevr_gt? :: int -> int -> bool

clevr_lt? :: int -> int -> bool

clevr_car :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrobject

clevr_if :: bool -> t0 -> t0 -> t0

clevr_empty :: list(tclevrobject)

clevr_fold :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> (tclevrobject -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_add :: tclevrobject -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_gray :: tclevrcolor

clevr_red :: tclevrcolor

clevr_blue :: tclevrcolor

clevr_green :: tclevrcolor

clevr_brown :: tclevrcolor

clevr_purple :: tclevrcolor

clevr_cyan :: tclevrcolor

clevr_yellow :: tclevrcolor

clevr_small :: tclevrsize

clevr_large :: tclevrsize

clevr_rubber :: tclevrmaterial

clevr_metal :: tclevrmaterial

clevr_cube :: tclevrshape

clevr_sphere :: tclevrshape

clevr_cylinder :: tclevrshape

clevr_left :: tclevrrelation

clevr_right :: tclevrrelation

clevr_behind :: tclevrrelation

clevr_front :: tclevrrelation

0 :: int

1 :: int

2 :: int

3 :: int

4 :: int

5 :: int

6 :: int

7 :: int

8 :: int

9 :: int

clevr_map :: (tclevrobject -> tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_transform_color :: tclevrcolor -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

clevr_transform_material :: tclevrmaterial -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

clevr_transform_size :: tclevrsize -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

clevr_transform_shape :: tclevrshape -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

count_objects_related_to_given_relation :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrrelation -> bool
(lambda (lambda (clevr_gt? (clevr_count (clevr_relate (clevr_car $1) $0 $1)) 2)))
description: This function counts the number of objects related to a given relation based on the first object in the list.

filter_objects_by_color :: tclevrcolor -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)
(lambda (lambda (clevr_fold $0 clevr_empty (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_color (clevr_query_color $1) $3) (clevr_add $1 $0) $0))))))
description: Filters a list of objects based on the specified color.

retrieve_objects_not_related_to_given_relation :: tclevrrelation -> list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrobject
(lambda (lambda (clevr_car (clevr_fold $0 $0 (lambda (lambda (clevr_difference $0 (clevr_relate $1 $3 $0))))))))
description: This function retrieves objects that are not related to a specified relation from a list of objects.

filter_objects_by_small_size :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)
(lambda (clevr_fold $0 clevr_empty (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_size (clevr_query_size $1) clevr_small) (clevr_add $1 $0) $0)))))
description: Filters a list of objects to only include objects that are of small size.

count_objects_related_to_objects_behind :: list(tclevrobject) -> int
(lambda (clevr_count (clevr_map (lambda (clevr_car $1)) (clevr_relate (clevr_car $0) clevr_behind $0))))
description: Counts the number of objects that are behind the first object in the list.

determine_shape_based_on_condition :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_shape (clevr_query_shape (clevr_car $0)) clevr_cylinder) $1 $2))))
description: Determines the shape of an object based on a specified condition involving the shape of the first object in a list of objects.

filter_objects_by_color_and_material :: tclevrcolor -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)
(lambda (lambda (clevr_fold $0 clevr_empty (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_color (clevr_if (clevr_eq_material (clevr_query_material $1) clevr_metal) clevr_red (clevr_query_color $1)) $3) (clevr_add $1 $0) $0))))))
description: Filters a list of objects based on both color and material criteria to find objects that match the specified color and material.

filter_objects_by_material_and_shape :: tclevrmaterial -> tclevrshape -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_fold $0 clevr_empty (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_shape (clevr_query_shape $1) $3) (clevr_if (clevr_eq_material (clevr_query_material $1) $4) (clevr_add $1 $0) $0) $0)))))))
description: Filters a list of objects based on both material and shape criteria to find objects that match the specified material and shape.

determine_shape_based_on_material_count :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrshape
(lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_material (clevr_if (clevr_gt? (clevr_count $0) 7) (clevr_query_material (clevr_car $0)) clevr_rubber) clevr_metal) clevr_sphere clevr_cylinder))
description: Determines the shape of an object based on the material count of objects in the list. If the material count is greater than 7, it compares the material of the first object in the list to metal and returns either a sphere or a cylinder shape.

determine_size_based_on_relation_count :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrrelation -> tclevrsize
(lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_lt? (clevr_count (clevr_relate (clevr_car $1) $0 $1)) 2) clevr_large clevr_small)))
description: Determines the size of an object based on the count of objects related to a given relation involving the first object in the list.
